all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Vocational Training Programme was established to provide unskilled workers with opportunities to acquire more qualified jobs, addressing structural unemployment in Canada. Additionally, the Government is offering grants of up to 50 percent of wages paid to workers over 45 years of age who are taken on and provided with on-the-job training, aiming to stimulate employment and skill development.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The reforms aim to enhance the skills of the workforce, thereby improving employability and addressing unemployment, which supports economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: Both components of the reform have been put into action to support workforce development.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reforms significantly contribute to skill development and employment but do not represent a structural overhaul of the system.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: Recognition of the structural aspects of unemployment led to the vote, in 1960, of a Vocational Training Programme designed to give unskilled workers the opportunity to take on more qualified jobs.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The primary focus is on providing vocational training and grants for wage support, which does not directly relate to R&D funding or knowledge transfer.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Federal Government is providing fiscal incentives, including a three-year exemption from corporation tax and accelerated depreciation for investment expenditure, to encourage private industry to invest in high-unemployment areas.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: These fiscal incentives are designed to stimulate private investment in areas with high unemployment, which can lead to job creation and economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The fiscal incentives have been actively provided to encourage investment in targeted areas.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reform provides significant support for private investment but does not fundamentally change the innovation landscape.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: the Federal Government is also offering a range of fiscal incentives (exemption for 3 years from the corporation tax and the possibility of claiming accelerated depreciation for investment expenditure) with a view to encouraging private industry to move into 35 high-unemployment areas.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The reform emphasizes fiscal incentives for private industry investment rather than direct public R&D funding or innovation instruments specifically aimed at R&D activities.
